fb0a7b5563f01ab892e839e3cd69@global-arts.address: Granoff Center for the Creative Arts
fb0a7b5563f01ab892e839e3cd69@global-arts.description: In her practice, Dayanita Singh experiments with form through photography, architecture, and books to create exhibitions. Using these mediums, Singh extends an invitation to audiences to question how books, and book-making, might transform a space into an exhibition. This show takes cues from Singh’s artist-led approach to exhibitions to explore the relationship between “making” and “reading.” With Singh’s Book Building (2022) as a blueprint, this exhibition analyzes book-making as an artistic practice, material form, and conceptual process. Works in the exhibition span Singh’s career, including Book Building (2022), Blue Book (2009), File Room (2013), Museum of Chance (2014), and Sent a Let

ca36db24c44ae1cac8f0fa9484ef@global-arts.description: A.I.-assisted computer programming has been a game-changer (for better or for worse) for beginners and experts alike. We’ll leave time to discuss!

c0bc5526cac5eaebc71f8bb6ee47@global-arts.title: Practical AI: Using Gemini’s “Deep Research” to Contextualize your Research Project
c0bc5526cac5eaebc71f8bb6ee47@global-arts.description: Join us for a hands-on workshop introducing Google Gemini’s “Deep Research” as a tool of contextualizing your research project. This workshop will begin with a brief overview of what generative AI is and what it is not. We will then discuss the usefulness of reference sources as a starting place for academic research. Following these foundational matters, we will have a hands-on activity where we use Gemini to generate custom reference sources with a key eye to the affordances and liabilities of the platform.

7597c8b5df9531b589f995f6d3f6@global-arts.description: Poet/filmmaker Alystyre Julian’s OUTRIDER is a kinetic portal into fast-speaking poet Anne Waldman’s transcendent role as a visionary word-worker, from her “hearthome” in Greenwich Village and The Poetry Project at St. Mark’s Church, to the Jack Kerouac School of Disembodied Poetics at Naropa University in Boulder, Colorado, and outwards to Big Sur, Morocco, and Mexico. From executive producer, Martin Scorcese, OUTRIDER is a portal to her path of imagination, her vow to poetry and activism, and her vortex of artists/collaborators: Patti Smith, Bob Dylan, Thurston Moore, Meredith Monk, Allen Ginsberg, Laurie Anderson, Douglas Dunn, Eileen Myles, Amiri Baraka, James Brandon Lewis, Cecilia Vicu

5bfe1623791ecd4cdb7f2c1251bf@global-arts.title: Exhibit | Centering Philippine and Filipinx American Histories: Selections from The Bancroft Library
5bfe1623791ecd4cdb7f2c1251bf@global-arts.description: The Bancroft Library’s collections of materials relating to the Philippines span nearly 500 years. Highlights in this exhibit include a transcript of an Inquisitorial trial from 1646, a prayer book written in the Cebuano language, and UC Berkeley Filipino student publications from 1905 to the present. The exhibit also features selections from the personal papers of acclaimed author Jessica Hagedorn, including typewritten drafts of her novels, poetry, song lyrics, and a screenplay, as well as childhood drawings and writings. Open hours may vary. Please view the The Bancroft Library hours page for the most up-to-date information.

b49f502d15ef6d5cb60c104f7fc4@global-arts.description: What does it mean to grow older in a queer body, surrounded by queer community? Join MODA’s Queer Figure Drawing Night with Ashanti Hampton for Queer Across Generations, a special session celebrating queer bodies across time. For this gathering, we’ll welcome a queer elder as our model and make space to consider the beauty, complexity, and possibility of aging. So many of us carry questions about what it means to grow older: Will I be allowed to age? What does it look like to grow older in my body and in my community? 857cb92a9fa83c2e04f8d0e817d1@global-arts.title: Graphic Design Studio: Hidden Histories
857cb92a9fa83c2e04f8d0e817d1@global-arts.description: In this virtual studio, young designers will explore how museums use graphic design to present historical information through exhibition graphics, labels, and promotional displays. Students will invent an ancient civilization or forgotten city, develop its history and culture. They’ll use Canva to create a poster or artifact label that introduces visitors to their discovery. They will combine typography, illustrations, symbols, maps, and historical details to create a design that feels both educational and imaginative. At the end of the studio, students can share their work and receive feedback in a supportive environment.

789d87b82b79a2ec0d20a56e5911@global-arts.title: Silent Night
789d87b82b79a2ec0d20a56e5911@global-arts.description: Silent Night is the powerful, true account of the spontaneous Christmas truce between French, British, and German soldiers during World War I. Based on the film “Joyeux Noël,” the story takes place on Christmas Eve, the opposing forces lay down their weapons, come together around a makeshift tree to sing carols, and play soccer matches. The soldiers’ peaceful actions are reprimanded by their commanders, but cast a lasting light on the goodness of humanity in the face of war. Artistic Director Tomer Zvulun will direct, and Principal Conductor Iván López Reynoso will conduct. 59891ef23041377735fce05486e7@global-arts.title: The Dynamic! – Funny scenes, songs and games!
59891ef23041377735fce05486e7@global-arts.description: The Dynamic! is an improv show that thrives on chaos, quick thinking, and whatever ideas the audience throws at the cast. Every scene, game, and musical moment is built in real time, and the performers lean into the unexpected with a mix of confidence, silliness, and genuine surprise. They know how to turn a wild suggestion or a joke that goes off the rails into something even funnier, and half the joy is watching them navigate the mess together. The show moves fast, the energy stays high, and no two nights ever feel the same. You help spark the fun, and the cast runs with it to create a comedy experience that feels alive, loose, and completely in the moment.

3c57ba5a953eee22798e2fa6e313@global-arts.description: Hambidge is set to premiere the fourth year of FILMED @ Hambidge, a collaborative project pairing filmmakers with artists across disciplines to capture the creative process on film. The 2026 featured pairings include Paras Chaudhari, filming Simone Baron; John Dierre, filming Summer Blanco and Jordan Argrett; Ebony Blanding, filming Michi Meko; and Priscila Torres, filming Coulter Fussell. 872e108003e743234b649a09039b@global-arts.title: Duruflé REQUIEM
872e108003e743234b649a09039b@global-arts.description: The Adult Choir and Schola of St. Luke’s Episcopal Church present Maurice Duruflé’s masterpiece in a concert setting, conducted by William Fred Scott. The concert will be preceded by a 6 p.m. lecture on the work by Ned Tipton, renowned student of the late Marie-Madeleine Duruflé and noted authority on the music of Maurice Duruflé. The concert features New York based mezzo-soprano Tami Petty and cellist Guang Wang, accompanied in the solo organ version by organists Matthew Michael Brown and Jonathan Easter.

7d46cdc3c5aa2dfbadad14f1c142@global-arts.description: Join MODA for a virtual studio and build a game where players explore ancient ruins. In this virtual studio, young designers will learn how to create an interactive adventure using Scratch. Students will design an ancient temple, forgotten city, or mysterious ruin filled with hidden passages, puzzles, treasures, and discoveries. Using block based coding, they will create movement, interactive objects, simple puzzles, and collectible artifacts as players explore their environment. At the end of the studio, students can share their work and receive feedback in a supportive environment.

f1c42b5ca65862d45e8f1b318dba@global-arts.title: Silent Night
f1c42b5ca65862d45e8f1b318dba@global-arts.description: Silent Night is the powerful, true account of the spontaneous Christmas truce between French, British, and German soldiers during World War I. Based on the film “Joyeux Noël,” the story takes place on Christmas Eve, the opposing forces lay down their weapons, come together around a makeshift tree to sing carols, and play soccer matches. The soldiers’ peaceful actions are reprimanded by their commanders, but cast a lasting light on the goodness of humanity in the face of war. Artistic Director Tomer Zvulun will direct, and Principal Conductor Iván López Reynoso will conduct. 3afa2ab509be50435f8a3be707ef@global-arts.description: The Harvest Home Concert is Redeemer’s musical celebration of Thanksgiving, a quintessentially American holiday, a celebration that crosses all barriers, featuring Redeemer choirs and instrumentalists. 167783cfb8773ef12086e04c17fd@global-arts.title: Oglethorpe Theatre presents Cyrano De Bergerac
167783cfb8773ef12086e04c17fd@global-arts.venue: Conant Performing Arts Center at Oglethorpe University
167783cfb8773ef12086e04c17fd@global-arts.description: A genius with language, Cyrano secretly loves the radiant Roxane, but she loves the beautiful but inarticulate Christian. Convinced of his own ugliness, Cyrano offers to act as a go-between and writes beautiful love letters for Christian to give to Roxane. This verbal deception sets in motion a poignant and often hilarious love triangle in which each character is torn between the lure of physical attraction and the seductive power of words. Martin Crimp’s radical adaptation reimagines the classic love story through spoken word, contemporary poetry and rap—creating a world where words are everything.

3eeb22c12d374158d448145c5544@global-arts.description: Ada Film Collective presents screenings and conversations around three short indie films by Igbo diasporic women filmmakers. d6bd12ba9c4057e4a0d9b6b1986c@global-arts.title: The Dynamic! – Funny scenes, songs and games!
d6bd12ba9c4057e4a0d9b6b1986c@global-arts.description: The Dynamic! is an improv show that thrives on chaos, quick thinking, and whatever ideas the audience throws at the cast. Every scene, game, and musical moment is built in real time, and the performers lean into the unexpected with a mix of confidence, silliness, and genuine surprise. They know how to turn a wild suggestion or a joke that goes off the rails into something even funnier, and half the joy is watching them navigate the mess together. The show moves fast, the energy stays high, and no two nights ever feel the same. You help spark the fun, and the cast runs with it to create a comedy experience that feels alive, loose, and completely in the moment.

d88b37252bcc19bff1bbf47134c4@global-arts.description: TRAD is a theatrical tear-down of the modern “trad wife” phenomenon and the Christian nationalist beliefs behind it, which also indulges our collective yearning for fantasies of escape. 710c53a1525102754cc808ca3b14@global-arts.title: Oglethorpe Theatre presents Cyrano De Bergerac
710c53a1525102754cc808ca3b14@global-arts.venue: Conant Performing Arts Center at Oglethorpe University
710c53a1525102754cc808ca3b14@global-arts.description: A genius with language, Cyrano secretly loves the radiant Roxane, but she loves the beautiful but inarticulate Christian. Convinced of his own ugliness, Cyrano offers to act as a go-between and writes beautiful love letters for Christian to give to Roxane. This verbal deception sets in motion a poignant and often hilarious love triangle in which each character is torn between the lure of physical attraction and the seductive power of words. Martin Crimp’s radical adaptation reimagines the classic love story through spoken word, contemporary poetry and rap—creating a world where words are everything.

3a5a8ce724cb69c705212e2c5b40@global-arts.title: DENTATA — Julia VanderVeen
3a5a8ce724cb69c705212e2c5b40@global-arts.address: 572 Edgewood Ave SE, Suite 116, Atlanta, GA, 30312
3a5a8ce724cb69c705212e2c5b40@global-arts.description: New work from an award-winning idiot. Join Beth Anne (a woman!), a middle-aged beauty queen (almost!), who has spent her life shape-shifting into what she thinks others want, only to realize she doesn’t know herself at all. She looks for her reflection in Medusa, the Sirens of The Odyssey, and the Weird Sisters of Macbeth. These misunderstood women pull her through the wreckage of her past, forcing her to confront the stories she’s been told about what it means to be beautiful, desirable, good and worthy. In a wild, theatrical unraveling, Beth Anne is ripped open and reborn as something powerful, ferocious and entirely her own. Written and performed by Julia VanderVeen. Directed by Jess Laza

363cf753ff9e67c113041710f9bd@global-arts.title: Oglethorpe Theatre presents Cyrano De Bergerac
363cf753ff9e67c113041710f9bd@global-arts.venue: Conant Performing Arts Center at Oglethorpe University
363cf753ff9e67c113041710f9bd@global-arts.description: A genius with language, Cyrano secretly loves the radiant Roxane, but she loves the beautiful but inarticulate Christian. Convinced of his own ugliness, Cyrano offers to act as a go-between and writes beautiful love letters for Christian to give to Roxane. This verbal deception sets in motion a poignant and often hilarious love triangle in which each character is torn between the lure of physical attraction and the seductive power of words. Martin Crimp’s radical adaptation reimagines the classic love story through spoken word, contemporary poetry and rap—creating a world where words are everything.

298bedecf110087d6473f14df1f1@global-arts.title: The Dynamic! – Funny scenes, songs and games!
298bedecf110087d6473f14df1f1@global-arts.description: The Dynamic! is an improv show that thrives on chaos, quick thinking, and whatever ideas the audience throws at the cast. Every scene, game, and musical moment is built in real time, and the performers lean into the unexpected with a mix of confidence, silliness, and genuine surprise. They know how to turn a wild suggestion or a joke that goes off the rails into something even funnier, and half the joy is watching them navigate the mess together. The show moves fast, the energy stays high, and no two nights ever feel the same. You help spark the fun, and the cast runs with it to create a comedy experience that feels alive, loose, and completely in the moment.

3f1266c53aa0113793268e1f3883@global-arts.description: The day after Thanksgiving is often known as one of the biggest shopping days of the year, but National Buy Nothing Day invites us to pause and think differently about consumption, community, and the impact of our choices. Join the Center for an afternoon of learning and reflection as we explore how everyday purchasing decisions affect people, communities, and the environment. Through engaging activities and conversations, visitors will gain new perspectives on ethical consumption and discover ways to make more intentional choices.

ba573abd3e2650a6fe9facee3f56@global-arts.title: The Dynamic! – Funny scenes, songs and games!
ba573abd3e2650a6fe9facee3f56@global-arts.description: The Dynamic! is an improv show that thrives on chaos, quick thinking, and whatever ideas the audience throws at the cast. Every scene, game, and musical moment is built in real time, and the performers lean into the unexpected with a mix of confidence, silliness, and genuine surprise. They know how to turn a wild suggestion or a joke that goes off the rails into something even funnier, and half the joy is watching them navigate the mess together. The show moves fast, the energy stays high, and no two nights ever feel the same. You help spark the fun, and the cast runs with it to create a comedy experience that feels alive, loose, and completely in the moment.

Desde entonces, ha trabajado en numerosas películas y series con directores como Andrés Wood, Sebastián Lelio y Martín Rejtman. 043dbab7156c6730e3be79109b6a@global-arts.description: Singapur, 1994: Ah Girl, de siete años, vive con su hermana pequeña, Ah Tian, su padre y su abuela tras la separación de sus padres. Cuando Mamá le pide a Ah Girl que elija si quiere vivir con ella, la niña se debate entre complacerla y quedarse con su padre y su hermana. A lo largo del año, Ah Girl empieza a comprender lo inusual y frágil que es su situación familiar. Sus padres inician nuevas relaciones, el dinero escasea y existe la posibilidad de que Ah Tian tenga que marcharse. 2fe3103b267324d89ba738e2286f@global-arts.description: Tras un año rodando en el extranjero, Manu, un actor de 39 años que en su día gozó de gran reconocimiento, regresa a su ciudad natal e intenta abrirse de nuevo camino en la industria. Contra todo pronóstico, consigue un trabajo como presentador de un programa nocturno de radio con llamadas en directo. En plena crisis existencial, Manu utiliza ese espacio para dar voz a las preguntas filosóficas que lo atormentan durante las largas noches. A través de sus conversaciones con los oyentes, un grupo de almas solitarias, su vida comienza a cobrar un nuevo sentido. > Coloquio posterior con Jennifer Alleyn Panorama internacional Nacida en Suiza, Jennifer Alleyn es una cineasta, escritora y fotógrafa

50e2d826331303549e3803fb0b24@global-arts.title: Timestamp
50e2d826331303549e3803fb0b24@global-arts.description: Mantener las escuelas abiertas en Ucrania es un intento de recuperar, al menos en parte, la normalidad que tenían antes de la guerra. Sin entrevistas, narración ni recreaciones, Timestamp ofrece una mirada a cómo la guerra está afectando a la vida cotidiana de estudiantes y profesores. La película tiene una estructura de mosaico: explora cómo funciona una escuela, tanto presencialmente como en línea, en estos tiempos terribles, tanto en el frente como lejos de él, y cómo la vida cotidiana está entrelazada con un peligro constante. Ahora, el pasado de Marie amenaza con alcanzarla y se ve obligada a hacer todo lo que esté en su mano para conservar su nueva posición como señora de la casa en medio de la anarquía de la posguerra. e30b533cc864560f42176da9c9dd@global-arts.description: Five figures are trapped in a temporal maze, mutating and colliding in an attempt to defy immortality. Confronted with different laws and physical phenomena, their bodies reveal other behaviors and possibilities of being, without knowing if they are at the twilight or dawn of their existence. 4cd3f0e53676b8a6787f011eb4a1@global-arts.title: Humanities in Asia: Going Beyond Make-Do-the Reshaping of a Chinese Operatic Tradition in Taiwan
4cd3f0e53676b8a6787f011eb4a1@global-arts.description: Kunqu, a 600-year-old form of Chinese opera known for its poetic lyrics and refined singing, was among the first Chinese art forms UNESCO recognized as a "Masterpiece of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity" in 2001. The story of how Kunqu survived the political upheavals of the twentieth century runs not only through state-sponsored troupes in China but also through communities of devoted amateur singers, known as quyou (曲友), who carried the tradition to Taiwan. This talk follows these enthusiasts from their roots in Mainland China to their postwar lives in Taiwan, where they kept Kunqu alive through informal singing gatherings long before it was celebrated as world heritage. 84bc87be1f5a1d6c2eff166b9807@global-arts.title: A Gift in Motion
84bc87be1f5a1d6c2eff166b9807@global-arts.description: A multidisciplinary showcase from the artists and scholars of the full-time faculty and staff at the Corcoran School of the Arts & Design. A Gift In Motion loosely draws from Robin Wall Kimmerer’s book The Serviceberry which uplifts Indigenous frameworks of the natural world to advance the possibilities in collectivity, reciprocity, and the mindset of abundance. These are anti-capitalist models and theories that provide insight into the systems of power we negotiate, but also offer a lens on how we individually move through our daily lives—together—through historically fraught landscapes. 0e0e837ba30ed008e60fccb66a5f@global-arts.description: Camp One Heartland is a solo exhibition by Tye DuSold-O’Connor archiving documentation of one of the world’s first nonprofit summer camps designated to supporting and empowering youth affected by HIV and AIDS, eventually transforming into a vital beacon of safety, liberation and eutopia for LGBTQ+ youth across the country. After its inaugural session in the summer of 1993 and many more held at different campsites across the country, Camp One Heartland found its permanent residence in Willow River, Minnesota. 883a0dc51b5680993a2257b85445@global-arts.description: REFLECT traces the evolution of artist Cannuap Hanska Luger’s Mirror Shield Project . In 2016, when the Dakota Access Pipeline threatened the waters of his ancestral homelands, Luger circulated a video demonstrating how to make “mirror shields” from inexpensive materials. Conceived during the Indigenous-led resistance at Standing Rock, North Dakota, the tutorial functioned as a call to collective action, an invitation for people across the country to stand in solidarity with the Water Protectors. e482bb446df12028f354c7896fea@global-arts.title: Cracks & Reforms: The 1920s Through the GW Collection
e482bb446df12028f354c7896fea@global-arts.description: The 1920s emerged as a decade suspended between collapse and reconstruction, an era marked by “cracks and reforms” that ushered in a profound reconfiguration of the visual world.  During this period marked by civil transformation and political upheaval, artists, journalists, and makers had opportunities to reconstruct both individual and collective identities. A century later, Cracks & Reforms presents a distinct cross-section of this period, revealing global currents of migration, modernization, and cultural redefinition through the lens of the GW Collection. Join Alina Potts , Research Scientist for GW's Global Women's Institute and Principal Investigator of the Empowered Aid project, for this lecture. RSVP here.

bd5bc85c053aa860a48b59477b9c@global-arts.description: A special series of events dedicated to honoring the rich religious, secular, spiritual, and philosophical diversity of our GW community. efb6c83a7e92521d2839737d78cb@global-arts.title: Rethinking Korea Policy: Towards a Free and Unified Korea
efb6c83a7e92521d2839737d78cb@global-arts.description: What would a free and unified Korean Peninsula look like, and what role should U.S. foreign policy play in making it a reality? Join the International Affairs Society for a conversation on the future of the Korean Peninsula, the challenges of reunification, and the role of international cooperation in advancing freedom and security. We’ll be joined by Hyun-Seung Lee, North Korean escapee and founder of the North Korean Young Leaders Assembly, and Col. David Maxwell (Ret.), former U.S. Army Special Forces Colonel and Vice President of the Center for Asia Pacific Strategy.

93aff8b11b556fb9cfb8173aa3e0@global-arts.title: Book Talk with Award-Winning Authors of “The Jailhouse Lawyer."
93aff8b11b556fb9cfb8173aa3e0@global-arts.description: A riveting discussion with the authors of the award-winning book, “The Jailhouse Lawyer.” Winner of the ABA’s 2026 Silver Gavel Award. John Grisham described the book as “so incredible it strains belief.” Come learn more about Calvin’s 28-year struggle to secure his release from prison for a crime he did not commit, and his recent victory in being elected Orleans Parish Clerk of Court, only for his political adversaries to successfully legislate him out of office.

0e93222ceaeef1c100883bf34a4e@global-arts.description: The 1920s emerged as a decade suspended between collapse and reconstruction, an era marked by “cracks and reforms” that ushered in a profound reconfiguration of the visual world.  During this period marked by civil transformation and political upheaval, artists, journalists, and makers had opportunities to reconstruct both individual and collective identities. 1430335cc4258151a1c107187c68@global-arts.title: The Illiberal Age? The Politics of Entrenchment
1430335cc4258151a1c107187c68@global-arts.description: The year 2026 has been a contrasting year for the global trajectory of illiberalism. While some countries are moving away from illiberal governments, others are entering their own illiberal transformations. Yet beyond electoral victories and defeats, illiberalism is becoming a durable feature of our political and cultural lives, increasingly entrenched in institutions, intellectual debates, cultural production, and collective imaginaries. Join Marlene Laruelle, editor of the Illiberalism Studies Program Yearbook, and contributors Laura K. Field (Niskanen Center and ILLSP), Zsolt Enyedi (Central European University), and Jean-François Drolet (Queen Mary University of London) for a discussion

Museums often served nationalist and imperialist interests in the past, but the primary force in the 21st century is the market. Museum franchising—exemplified by the Louvre Abu Dhabi—is one of the most visible cases of the increasing entanglement of art and museums with capital interests. 4ea6f9f25f00b9486bff2dbacc31@global-arts.title: Exhibit | Centering Philippine and Filipinx American Histories: Selections from The Bancroft Library
4ea6f9f25f00b9486bff2dbacc31@global-arts.description: The Bancroft Library’s collections of materials relating to the Philippines span nearly 500 years. Highlights in this exhibit include a transcript of an Inquisitorial trial from 1646, a prayer book written in the Cebuano language, and UC Berkeley Filipino student publications from 1905 to the present. The exhibit also features selections from the personal papers of acclaimed author Jessica Hagedorn, including typewritten drafts of her novels, poetry, song lyrics, and a screenplay, as well as childhood drawings and writings. Open hours may vary. Please view the The Bancroft Library hours page for the most up-to-date information.
